narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On July 2, 2024, at approximately 0600 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at his residence in Pontiac, Michigan, while executing an administrative warrant issued for him after fingerprint records matched a prior removal.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no documents to be in the United States.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
An immigration judge in Atlanta, Georgia, ordered the subject removed on 08/30/2012, and the order was carried out on 10/04/2012, when officers escorted him across the international bridge at Laredo, Texas, into Nuevo Laredo.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he reentered the United States illegally, wading across the river near Laredo, in June 2016, and that he never applied for permission to return.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is being presented for prosecution under 8 U.S.C. 1326 as an alien found in the United States after removal.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station and the case was accepted for prosecution.
